visualReview.notes: All nine current portable views inspected, including both new entrance close-ups. Six physical recesses have inward-facing arched reveals, thresholds, opaque paired doors and recessed fanlights. The thin head-band seam found in the first render was closed before these final captures. Existing body dimensions, roofs, cupola and ground retained.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All nine current shared-material views inspected, including mapped footprint overlay and both entrance details. Recesses read with actual shadows and consistent stone/brick/metal bindings. Placement/transform and unload pass. Flat placement fixture tests mapped alignment, not independent ground accuracy.

mediumFiReview.notes: All 21 current version-2 frames inspected across lights, quality modes, detail cameras and all four forced levels. Arched recesses survive distance simplification. Existing three-floor/bay rhythm, roof and open cupola remain. Context neighbors are synthetic style evidence.

geographicReview.notes: Original hall/cupola outlines, anchor [-71.05623431503773,42.36003337249992], heading 1.7056862578319953, +X north-northwest/+Z east-northeast retained. Map vectors independently locate the cupola toward Quincy Market. Original entrance reference [0,15.9], provider-relative datum 5.5784 m, source relief -0.012635..0.171418 m and -0.75 m foundation retained byte-for-byte. New recesses occupy existing facade volume. Source-native details and current mapped overlay inspected. Approximate source-relative exterior placement; not surveyed paving/floor levels or certification of another host field. No flattening, height fitting or new cutout.

fidelityReview.scope: Historic hall exterior with six real gable entrance recesses, paired opaque doors, fanlights, thresholds and inward-facing curved reveals; market neighbors and interiors excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Two exact NPS native originals with explicit public-domain grants replace attribution-licensed references after starting with the local Qualla corpus. Both originals show the west gable. Three western doorways, arched fanlights, pale reveals and thresholds control the new construction; three eastern doorways retain the existing conservative symmetry approximation. The 0.55 m recess depth, pane/panel counts, color, exact elevations, unseen sides and 2026 condition are estimates. Main frame, ground, roof, cupola, floor bands and mapped dimensions retained. No source pixels embedded and no navigable interior claimed.

runtimeLodReview.notes: 972/3880/14812/17476 triangles, 1/5/5/5 draws pass strict budgets. All four authored levels preserve real door recesses and thresholds. District simplifies shallow pilaster shafts to retain important entrance geometry within budget. Error bounds are authoring estimates, not an independent surface-distance certificate.

geometryValidation.notes: Targeted generation/import/exact regeneration, asset integrity, strict LOD/material budgets, source/imported Float32 normals/winding/UVs and six-entrance air/door/fanlight/floor/curved reveal/jamb controls pass. Two focused NPS source-policy tests pass; pure agency NPS Photo credit still requires exact ID, original URL/bytes and explicit public-domain grant. Private credit suffixes remain rejected.

limitations: Original medium-fi exterior: Qualla corpus searched first; current entrance construction uses two inspected NPS originals with explicit public-domain grants. Generalized hall/cupola footprints and retained photographic proportions are not a measured survey.

The west gable doors, arched fanlights and white reveals are visible in the NPS originals. East gable entrance distribution is retained as a conservative symmetry approximation. Recess depth 0.55 m is estimated; opaque leaves terminate the exterior, with no navigable interior.

Facade bay rhythm, arched fanlights, pilasters, cornices, gables, open lantern and grasshopper silhouette are retained. Fine Corinthian ornament, pane counts, access ramps, plaques and hidden roof service details are simplified.
Only historic Faneuil Hall is included. Quincy Market, neighboring market buildings, plaza furniture and interiors are excluded.
Height estimates and entrance datum are photographic/map interpretations. Other host elevation datasets may require a new placement review.
Qualla corpus and exact supplemental NPS originals/rights are recorded with the source; no photographs are embedded or redistributed in the runtime pack.

identityMigration.basis: Identity-only rename; exact source/runtime/LOD/heightfield/capture bytes verified unchanged. Existing visual inspection findings retained. No new capture or changed geometry is claimed.
